mapper.select: SELECT SERIAL_NUMBER, REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, MODIFY_DATE, MODIFY_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, CANCEL_DATE, USE_BIT, BIKE_ITEM_SERIAL, UNIT_NAME, UNIT_EN_NAME, UNIT_NICK_NAME, UNIT_CODE, UNIT_COST, UNIT_TAX, UNIT_PRICE, UNIT_LIMIT, MEMO FROM CM_BIKE_ITEM_UNIT WHERE CANCEL_BIT = 'N' AND USE_BIT = 'Y' AND BIKE_ITEM_SERIAL = #{bikeItemSerial} ORDER BY SERIAL_NUMBER

SELECT SERIAL_NUMBER, REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, MODIFY_DATE, MODIFY_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, CANCEL_DATE, USE_BIT, BIKE_ITEM_SERIAL, UNIT_NAME, UNIT_EN_NAME, UNIT_NICK_NAME, UNIT_CODE, UNIT_COST, UNIT_TAX, UNIT_PRICE, UNIT_LIMIT, MEMO FROM CM_BIKE_ITEM_UNIT WHERE CANCEL_BIT = 'N' AND SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CM_BIKE_ITEM_UNIT ( REGIST_DATE, REGIST_IP, CANCEL_BIT, CANCEL_REASON, USE_BIT, BIKE_ITEM_SERIAL, UNIT_NAME, UNIT_EN_NAME, UNIT_NICK_NAME, UNIT_CODE, UNIT_COST, UNIT_TAX, UNIT_PRICE, UNIT_LIMIT, MEMO ) VALUES ( NOW(), #{registIp}, 'N', '00', #{useBit}, #{bikeItemSerial}, #{unitName}, #{unitEnName}, #{unitNickName}, #{unitCode}, #{unitCost}, #{unitTax}, #{unitPrice}, #{unitLimit}, #{memo} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CM_BIKE_ITEM_UNIT SET MODIFY_DATE = NOW(), MODIFY_IP = #{modifyIp}, USE_BIT = #{useBit}, UNIT_NAME = #{unitName}, UNIT_EN_NAME = #{unitEnName}, UNIT_NICK_NAME = #{unitNickName}, UNIT_CODE = #{unitCode}, UNIT_COST = #{unitCost}, UNIT_TAX = #{unitTax}, UNIT_PRICE = #{unitPrice}, UNIT_LIMIT = #{unitLimit}, MEMO = #{memo} WHERE SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
UPDATE CM_BIKE_ITEM_UNIT SET CANCEL_BIT = 'Y', CANCEL_DATE = NOW() WHERE SERIAL_NUMBER = #{serialNumber}
